grades.name: ATTRIBUTED_ASSOCIATION
grades.allowed: cohort hypothesis + prioritization for future test

rules: A higher grade cannot repair failed data-quality checks.
CRM attribution never exceeds C1 by itself.
A single customer outcome is C0 even if commercially large.
Observational causal analysis cannot exceed C2 without randomization.
Randomization at contact level is invalid for a multi-thread account treatment when contacts can influence the same opportunity; use account/account-product clusters.
